Digital baseball simulator , combining smart pitching machines, 3D visuals, infrared sensing and immersive effects. Merges intelligent tech with traditional sports for baseball training & entertainment.



>> Features of Baseball Simulator:


  • Smart Pitching Machines: Real-time pitch speed and trajectory adjustments, simulating a wide range of pitchers.

  • 3D Visuals: High-quality graphics that replicate realistic baseball stadiums and gameplay scenarios.

  • Infrared Sensing: Precise tracking of bat and ball contact for accurate performance feedback.

  • Immersive Effects: Surround sound and visual effects that replicate the atmosphere of a real baseball game.

  • Multi-Mode Options: Includes training mode, practice mode, and competitive multiplayer mode.



>> Advantages and Applications for the Baseball Simulator:


Baseball Training: Ideal for players looking to improve their batting, pitching, and reaction times.


Entertainment: Perfect for baseball enthusiasts and gamers, offering a fun and competitive experience.


Real-Time Feedback: Instant feedback on performance, including pitch accuracy, bat speed, and swing technique.


Versatile Use: Suitable for sports training facilities, clubs, home use, and arcade-style entertainment.


Customizable Settings: Adjust difficulty, pitch type, and environment for a personalized experience.



>> Product Number: LJST004


  • Floor area: 10m*4.5m*3m

  • Number of people: 1-2 person

  • Participation time: 3-10 minutes

  • Power: 600w



>> FAQs for Baseball Simulator:


Q1: Is this suitable for both beginners and advanced players?

A1: Yes, the Baseball Simulator offers adjustable difficulty settings, making it suitable for players of all skill levels.


Q2: What equipment do I need to use the simulator?

A2: You will need a standard baseball bat and a ball. The simulator works with infrared sensors to detect ball and bat interaction. The system may also be integrated with motion-tracking devices for enhanced gameplay.


Q3: How realistic is the pitching experience?

A3: The smart pitching machine can replicate various pitch types, speeds, and ball trajectories to provide a highly realistic experience.


Q4: Can I play with others?

A4: Yes, the Baseball Simulator supports multiplayer modes, allowing you to compete with friends or practice against AI opponents.


Q5: Can this simulator be used for professional baseball training?

A5: Absolutely. The simulator provides detailed performance analytics, making it an excellent tool for both amateur and professional training, helping players refine their skills with precision.
